title: ClassifierFeedback
description: Single feedback record. classifier_feedback.jsonl is a newline-delimited file where every line matches this schema. Append-only — never edited or reordered. One row per action taken by the user during a classification review session in insight-generator (Pass 8). Consumed by future classification passes as a learning signal — repeated user corrections on a given signal type cause that signal to be down-weighted.

ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the user acted on the classification review row.

event_seq.description: The seq of the event being reviewed. References events.jsonl.

user_action.description: What the user did with the row. 'confirmed' = accepted the classifier's assignment. 'changed' = reassigned to a different thread (a corresponding reclassification event was appended to events.jsonl). 'skipped' = left unreviewed (current classification stands but no explicit confirmation signal).

old_primary.description: The primary_thread_id that was on the event before this review action. Null if the event had no classification (pure ambiguous).

new_primary.description: The primary_thread_id the user picked (if user_action='changed'). Equal to old_primary if 'confirmed'. Null if 'skipped'.

signals_used.description: Which classifier signals contributed to the original assignment. If user_action='changed', these are the signals that misfired — the classifier should down-weight them for this source/pattern going forward.

confidence_before.description: The classification_confidence value on the event at review time.

review_session_ts.description: Timestamp of the parent classification_review event this row belongs to. Lets readers group per-row feedback by the aggregate review run.

notes.description: Optional free-text note from the user when they changed a classification (e.g., 'rio@ is only Acme Restaurant, not the holding').
